# Agent K C++ project language service

A C++ workspace is a folder containing CMakeLists.txt. Pass its folder name, not a path. Call agent_k_cpp_language_server with status at the start of a C++ language-service workflow. References, definitions, declarations, type declarations, implementations, hover, symbol search, diagnostics, document symbols, call hierarchy, and type hierarchy require that named workspace to be loaded and ready.

For semantic C++ questions in a ready workspace, use the Language Skill before grep, rg, findstr, compiler-output scraping, or custom Clang shell commands. Shell is for builds, tests, execution, Git, and explicitly textual or regex searches. If clangd returns no result, report that first and identify any later text search as supplementary rather than equivalent semantic evidence.

Keep useful C++ workspaces loaded. Do not unload and reload between queries, load preemptively for unrelated questions, or repeat a lifecycle action when status already reports the desired state. Use load and unload only for an intentional workspace lifecycle change. Use normal Pi file tools for edits and Agent K's project terminal for builds.
